# Lyric

Lyric declares [9 subprocessors](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/lyric#subprocessors) in [its subprocessor list](https://security.lyric.tech/?itemUid=e3fae2ca-94a9-416b-b577-5c90e382df57), which we last checked on 2026-11-10 ([evidence](https://thirdpartyindex.com/evidence/223994)). They include [Google Cloud](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/google-cloud), [OpenAI](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/openai) and [Microsoft](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/microsoft). No published changes since we first read it on 2026-11-06.

## Web Technologies

Lyric's homepage made 427 requests to 13 domains, 7 services controlled by another company, and 1 domain not identified. Loaded on 2026-11-06 by a browser that accepted nothing; other visits may load more or less. What a page loads is not a list of who receives customer data.

7 third parties by category: Analytics 3 (Clay, Google Cloud, RB2B); CDN 2 (jsDelivr, UNPKG); Cookie compliance 1 (Cookiebot); JavaScript libraries 1 (Webflow). Each company that appears controlled by another organization is counted once, under the main category of the technologies detected from it on this homepage or, when none was, the category recorded from the company's own page (marked reviewed) or else the one it is usually detected as on other published homepages (marked as such); unclassified: none of these.
